name: Event planner
description: Everything on the calendar, read as a plan.
long_description:
The initiative's events laid out the way an organizer thinks: the next eight weeks stacked by calendar, every scheduled event on a weekly timeline, with the full list underneath for the details a bar can't carry.

Nothing here needs setting up — every widget reads the calendars of the initiative the dashboard lives on.
release_notes: Adds Coming up, week by week: the next eight weeks of events, stacked by calendar.

binding.sql: SELECT count(*) AS events FROM calendar_events WHERE start_at >= now() AND start_at < now() + CAST('30 days' AS interval)
SELECT calendar.name AS calendar, count(*) AS events FROM calendar_events WHERE calendar.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY calendar.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

SELECT date_trunc('week', start_at) AS week, calendar.name AS calendar, count(*) AS events FROM calendar_events WHERE start_at >= now() AND start_at < now() + CAST('56 days' AS interval) AND calendar.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT title, start_at, end_at FROM calendar_events ORDER BY start_at
SELECT title, start_at, end_at, location FROM calendar_events ORDER BY start_at
